name: Ranger: Pantry navigation migration
summary: Move a recipe app to Expo Router while preserving nested tabs, headers, modal navigation and old deep links.
prompt: Please migrate Pantry to Expo Router as described in NAVIGATION.md. The current app starts in App.tsx, with screens and recipe data in src/. Keep the current screen content while moving navigation to the URL structure in the spec. Dependencies are already listed in package.json; do not install packages or use the network. No simulator or device is available here.

checks.label: Routes and navigator structure match the spec
App entry, links and modal behavior survive migration
